remarks: Newer, Spacious townhome in Desirable Palmer Square - Mere Steps and you're on the Path to the popular public Golf Course! Enjoy life in a Pet Friendly community with economic gas heat, central air + No ADDITIONAL FEES! This pretty home offers its own Private Entrance, extra windows, hardwood flooring & entertainer's open kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances! French doors from the dining area lead to the generous balcony overlooking the courtyard green. Upstairs (NEW CARPET TO BE INSTALLED), you'll find 2 bedrooms, 2 baths and private Washer/Dryer. Come see this immaculately presented bright space, wonderfully situated within the complex - close to the golf course path! Beautifully maintained community features: On-Site Management, 24-Hour Security & Parking for 2-Cars. Pets are welcome with the following guidelines: 2 Dogs 35 Lbs., 1 Dog max 60 lbs., or 1-dog + 1-Cat or 2-Cats OK. $300 fully refundable pet deposit per pet required. Palmer Square is a No Smoking Community. Interested parties please complete a Palmer Square application uploaded in supplements, and supply a credit check through Applyconnect only. SECOND FLOOR CARPETING BEING REPLACED WEEK OF 4/7.
